<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="photo" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
      <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4A4A4A"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".72"/>
      <stop offset="52%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".18"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="blur">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="18"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="shadow">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".45"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <g filter="url(#blur)" opacity=".92">
    <rect x="-20" y="-20" width="430" height="760" fill="url(#photo)"/>
    <path d="M-30 420 C45 330 92 350 138 416 S250 535 430 380 L430 760 L-30 760Z" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".72"/>
    <path d="M-20 180 C60 90 138 112 186 192 S286 300 430 220 L430 -20 L-20 -20Z" fill="#FF7854" opacity=".55"/>
    <path d="M20 710 C84 610 162 595 220 652 S328 718 420 602 L420 790 L20 790Z" fill="#000000" opacity=".58"/>
    <path d="M270 50 C222 144 246 240 331 282 C365 298 398 286 423 251 L423 20Z" fill="#FE3675" opacity=".6"/>
    <path d="M-20 300 C63 252 122 267 169 332 C208 386 256 408 420 330" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".17" stroke-width="44"/>
    <path d="M-20 560 C74 486 128 495 183 548 C240 604 307 602 420 526" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-opacity=".3" stroke-width="70"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="760" fill="url(#shade)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".3"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">9:41</text>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="333" y1="19" x2="333" y2="16"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="19" x2="338" y2="13"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="19" x2="343" y2="10"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="19" x2="348" y2="7"/>
    <circle cx="362" cy="14" r="5"/>
    <line x1="366" y1="18" x2="370" y2="22"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="375" y="8" width="13" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="377" y="10" width="9" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="388" y="12" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <polyline points="32,67 22,77 32,87" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="23" y1="77" x2="50" y2="77" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="84" r="43" fill="#4A4A4A" fill-opacity=".75" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".7" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="73" r="13" fill="#D0CECD"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="103" rx="25" ry="14" fill="#939393"/>
  <text x="195" y="157" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500">Lina Headley</text>
  <text x="195" y="184" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity=".82" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400">
    <tspan x="195" dy="0">Audio call</tspan>
    <tspan x="195" dy="22">04:28</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- ambient audio indicator -->
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".62" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <line x1="126" y1="260" x2="126" y2="280" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="138" y1="250" x2="138" y2="290" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="267" x2="150" y2="276" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="240" y1="267" x2="240" y2="276" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="252" y1="250" x2="252" y2="290" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="264" y1="260" x2="264" y2="280" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="195" cy="270" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>

  <!-- control buttons -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="38" y="488" width="66" height="66" rx="33" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".48" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".22"/>
    <rect x="118" y="488" width="66" height="66" rx="33" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".48" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".22"/>
    <rect x="198" y="488" width="66" height="66" rx="33" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".48" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".22"/>
    <rect x="278" y="488" width="66" height="66" rx="33" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".48" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".22"/>
  </g>

  <!-- video icon -->
  <rect x="55" y="510" width="24" height="18" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="79,514 88,509 88,529 79,524" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- mute icon -->
  <rect x="141" y="510" width="10" height="18" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="135,520 135,525 146,534 157,525 157,520" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="146" y1="534" x2="146" y2="538" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="137" y1="508" x2="158" y2="532" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- speaker icon -->
  <polygon points="216,517 224,517 234,509 234,530 224,522 216,522" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <path d="M239 514 C245 519 245 521 239 526" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M244 509 C254 517 254 523 244 531" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- add person -->
  <circle cx="307" cy="516" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="307" cy="531" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="516" x2="330" y2="530" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="523" x2="337" y2="523" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="195" y="580" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">
    <tspan x="71" text-anchor="middle">Video</tspan>
    <tspan x="151" text-anchor="middle">Mute</tspan>
    <tspan x="231" text-anchor="middle">Speaker</tspan>
    <tspan x="311" text-anchor="middle">Add</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- end call -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="163" y="635" width="64" height="64" rx="32" fill="#C42936"/>
  </g>
  <path d="M178 658 C186 650 204 650 212 658 L207 666 C201 663 189 663 183 666Z" fill="#FFFFFF" transform="rotate(18 195 660)"/>
  <line x1="179" y1="650" x2="212" y2="677" stroke="#C42936" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(-18 195 663)"/>
  <text x="195" y="722" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">End call</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".78"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".16"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polygon points="39,785 49,777 59,785 59,798 39,798"/>
    <polyline points="36,785 49,774 62,785"/>
    <circle cx="127" cy="783" r="8"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="797" x2="133" y2="797"/>
    <polygon points="190,777 194,789 207,789 197,797 201,809 190,802 179,809 183,797 173,789 186,789"/>
    <circle cx="273" cy="786" r="9"/>
    <polyline points="267,801 273,796 279,801"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="782" r="6"/>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="798" rx="12" ry="6"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="831" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500">
    <tspan x="49" text-anchor="middle">Home</tspan>
    <tspan x="127" text-anchor="middle">Chats</tspan>
    <tspan x="190" text-anchor="middle">Matches</tspan>
    <tspan x="273" text-anchor="middle">Calls</tspan>
    <tspan x="345" text-anchor="middle">Profile</tspan>
  </text>
</svg>
